records.title: Changes
records.review:
The last couple of recent updates to the app have made it far worse. On the Home Screen you now have sections in a set order. You now have to scroll to look at my credit card balances previously you could order all my accounts to put the most frequently used at the top. If this change into sections is permanent then allow the section order to be changed.
How a credit card itself is now displayed is very messy and not user friendly. You have to scroll through manage credit limit, balance transfer and money transfer option to get to transactions. It then only shows the last 3 and you have now a separate button for all transactions. This now looks like it’s being used to sell options like balance transfer etc rather than to easily manage your credit card. It would be better to have the transactions button as the 1st option. Managing your credit limit isn’t going to be the most used option when viewing a credit card but is the 1st option this doesn’t make sense. 
Both of the above changes don’t seem to have been user tested they look to be top down changes rather than through user/customer feedback/testing/demands.
It would be great for the changes to be user led as up until now the app has been well thought out.
